Patrick Melton (born June 18, 1975) is an American screenwriter, producer and novelist.


== Background ==
Melton was born in Champaign, Illinois, but grew up mostly in Evanston, Illinois. He attended Evanston Township High School, and graduated from the University of Iowa with a Bachelor's Degree in Communication Studies.
